watches.name: Dual Time Mini – Tiger Eye & Opal Diamonds
watches.description: The ALD Mini Dual Time introduces a new dimension to the ALD Mini. Two cases are stacked, forming a dual-layer construction that houses two independent time displays within a single, unified form. The two cases are connected through a discreet quick-release system, allowing the watch to be easily separated and changed without the use of any tools. Worn together, it expresses a dual timepiece; worn separately, it returns to its most reduced form. As with the ALD Mini, our natural stones dials reveal unique variations shaped by light and material. The Dual Time becomes not only a tool for multiple time zones, but an exploration of perspective.

watches.name: ALD Checker Full Set Capsule Collection
watches.description: Presenting the three interpretations of the collection’s central study of geometry, contrast and light. Across the trio, diamond pavé and deep black surfaces are arranged in distinct compositions from the measured horizontal division of Balance, through the four-quadrant symmetry of Gambit, to the deliberately disrupted geometry of Draw. Together, the three watches reveal the Checker concept in its entirety, with each piece exploring a different relationship between positive and negative space. Presented in a bespoke Dennison box, the set is accompanied by three additional genuine alligator leather straps in Pink, Orange and Turquoise, allowing the character of each watch to be further transformed. Conceived as the definitive expression of the Checker Capsule Collection, The Set brings all three designs together as a complete study rather than three individual variations.

watches.name: ALD Checker Balance
watches.description: Balance is the most restrained expression of the Checker Collection. Its dial is divided horizontally between two opposing surfaces: a field of brilliant-set diamonds above and deep black below. The simplicity of the division gives the watch its character, allowing light and darkness, ornament and restraint, to exist in equal measure. The geometry feels deliberate rather than decorative, with the familiar rounded form of the ALD case providing a softer frame around the graphic dial. The composition continues beyond the dial itself, with the diamond-set case becoming an integral part of the design rather than simply an embellishment around it. The result is a piece that plays with contrast without becoming excessive: half brilliance, half absence. Of the three Checker designs, Balance is the clearest reduction of the collection’s central idea taking the visual language of the checkerboard and distilling it into two opposing halves.

watches.name: ALD Checker Draw
watches.description: Draw takes the Checker concept and disrupts its symmetry. A concentrated field of diamonds occupies one side of the dial before meeting an expanse of uninterrupted black, creating an intentionally off-centre composition. Where Balance is horizontal and Gambit is perfectly divided, Draw introduces tension: the two surfaces appear to compete for space, giving the watch a sense of movement despite the starkness of its geometry. That contrast is reinforced by the diamond-set case, which carries the brilliance of the dial outward and makes the case itself part of the composition. Against this continuous setting, the black section becomes even more pronounced, creating negative space within an otherwise highly decorative object. Draw captures the more unconventional side of the Checker Collection using asymmetry, material and contrast to turn a familiar visual language into something distinctly Dennison.

watches.name: ALD Checker Gambit
watches.description: Gambit presents the Checker Collection in its most literal and graphic form. Four alternating quadrants of diamond pavé and polished black create a miniature checkerboard across the dial, transforming the surface of the watch into a study of symmetry, contrast and repetition. The absence of conventional hour markers allows the composition itself to dominate, while Dennison’s signature sits discreetly within the lower black quadrant. The pattern extends into the diamond-set case, deliberately blurring the distinction between dial and exterior architecture. Rather than treating the case as a frame, Gambit incorporates it into the visual rhythm of the watch, creating a continuous relationship between surface, setting and form. The precision required for the four sections to meet cleanly at the centre gives an apparently simple graphic an unexpectedly intricate execution a playful idea resolved with exactness.

watches.name: Mini Opal in Gold
watches.description: The ALD Mini - Reduced in size yet heightened in presence, it brings the watch closer to the wearer - both physically and conceptually. Its compact form allows material, light, and surface to take precedence, revealing a quieter, more intimate expression of the ALD collection. The ALD Mini Opal Mosaic introduces natural opal to Dennison’s compact ALD Mini. Individual fragments of natural opal are precisely cut and assembled into an intricate mosaic, creating a dial that continually shifts in colour as it catches the light. Flashes of blue, green, pink, orange and violet emerge across the surface, with the natural variation of the material ensuring that no two dials are exactly alike. Executed in stainless steel or gold PVD, and paired with leather or mesh, the ALD Mini is conceived as an object of precision and balance - a watch designed to be worn effortlessly, and observed over time.

watches.name: Time Keeper Edition
watches.description: A dialogue between watchmaking heritage and the visual language of the Gulf. Created exclusively with Time Keeper Qatar, this limited edition reinterprets the Dennison ALD through a distinctly regional lens. At its centre sits a natural Pietersite stone dial, each displaying its own dramatic composition of deep blues, bronze and charcoal hues formed over millions of years. No two watches are ever alike, ensuring every piece carries its own unique character. For the first time in Dennison’s modern history, the dial features applied quarterly Eastern Arabic numerals, introducing a subtle yet meaningful expression of local identity while preserving the restraint and balance that define the ALD collection. Rather than dominating the design, the numerals sit naturally within the architecture of the dial, creating a watch that feels both contemporary and timeless. Housed within the signature 37 × 33.5mm cushion-shaped case originally designed by Emmanuel Gueit, the watch is available in both stainless steel and gold PVD and is powered by the reliable Swiss Ronda Calibre 1062 quartz movement. A sapphire crystal protects the dial, while owners can choose between Dennison’s distinctive Bark-Mesh steel bracelet or an embossed brown crocodile leather strap, offering two equally refined interpretations of the watch. The Time Keeper Qatar Edition represents more than a regional exclusive. It is a celebration of shared values: thoughtful design, enduring craftsmanship and a growing community of collectors who appreciate watches not simply as instruments of time, but as objects of culture. Limited in production and available exclusively through Time Keeper Qatar, this collaboration marks another chapter in Dennison’s continued global story while paying tribute to one of the world’s most passionate and discerning watch communities.

watches.name: ALD Dual Time “Carnaby Blue” Time+Tide Studio Edition
watches.description: Created in collaboration with Time+Tide, the ALD Dual Time “Carnaby Blue” is a new interpretation of Dennison’s signature cushion case, pairing a mosaic blue mother-of pearl dial with the distinctive dual-time architecture of the ALD collection. The edition takes its name and inspiration from London in the 1960s, a period when British fashion, music, graphic design and youth culture began to exert an influence far beyond the city itself. Carnaby Street became one of the symbols of this new creative confidence: expressive, colourful and increasingly unconcerned with the traditional boundaries between formal and casual dress. At the centre of the watch is a marquetry dial constructed from individual fragments of blue mother-of-pearl. Each piece responds differently to changing light, moving between deep, almost inky blues and brighter flashes of turquoise, silver and pink. The fragmented construction gives the dial a graphic quality from a distance and reveals a much more intricate composition when viewed closely. Mother-of-pearl is a natural material, meaning variations in tone, texture and reflection are inherent to every dial. No two examples are exactly alike. The dial is housed within Dennison’s polished stainless steel cushion case, measuring 35.6mm across, 37mm lug-to-lug and just 6.1mm in thickness. Its compact dimensions and low profile reference the proportions traditionally associated with dress watches, while the unconventional dial and dual time display give the watch a distinctly contemporary character. The ALD Dual Time displays two independent time zones on a single dial. Rather than employing a conventional GMT mechanism, two Swiss Ronda 1032 quartz movements operate independently within the case, with each movement controlling its own set of hands. The result is both functional and graphic: two separate indications brought together within one composition. Despite housing two movements, the case retains the slimness that defines the ALD collection. A sapphire crystal protects the dial, while water resistance is rated to 30 metres. A blue denim strap completes the edition, introducing a more relaxed material against the polished case and mother of pearl dial. The choice also references the changing language of British dress during the period that inspired the watch, when denim increasingly existed alongside tailoring rather than in opposition to it.

watches.name: Shades Of Green
watches.description: The ALD Dual Time “Shades” Dial introduces a new dimension to Dennison’s design language. A study in nuance, where colour, light, and time are in constant motion. Developed with Emmanuel Gueit, the dials are rendered in a single tone with contrasting vertical and horizontal brushed finishes that continuously evolve with light. Paired with the new Dennison Pebble-link bracelet, the watch offers a fluid, cohesive silhouette. Option for Taupe leather strap instead. The Dual Time complication remains at the core, designed for those moving between time zones.

An embossed brown leather strap with a bespoke pin-buckle complements the case’s elegant finish. Additional strap colours can be added to your order, offering versatile ways to match the ethereal glow of the White MOP Ghost.

watches.name: Time+Tide X Dennison 'DateNight'
watches.description: The ‘DateNight’ marks two important premieres: its first-ever mother of pearl dial, and its first use of the intricate marquetry technique. Rectangular filaments of the Australian mother of pearl are meticulously hand-inlaid into the dial, creating an iridescent surface that shimmers and shifts with every movement. For Time+Tide, this watch represents a debut in dress watch territory - and the name says it all. The ‘DateNight’ is powered by a Swiss-made Ronda quartz movement, ensuring precision and reliability with minimal upkeep. The 37 x 33mm diameter case, sitting just 6mm off the wrist, is the Goldilocks size for unisex wear. Its slate grey suede strap, crafted by Belgian strapmakerMolequin, is celebrated for its supple, pre-worn style comfort and meticulous finishing. A super-slim white leather strap is also available for a lighter, more formal look. On the reverse, the caseback reveals a charmingly detailed engraving: the doorway of Time+Tide’s London Watch Discovery Studio, illustrated by the brand’s Australian Studio Manager, Alex Hindley - a subtle nod to the watch’s creative home. The dial features Natural Malachite, a vibrant green stone known for its rich bands and tonal depth, each one expertly cut and polished to reveal its unique character. Available in stainless steel, the case measures 37mm by 33.5mm, and 6mm thickness. Complemented by an embossed green leather strap with a bespoke pin-buckle that reflects the elegant curvature and finish of the case. A testament to enduring style and subtle detail. Additional colour straps can be added to your order.
